user.title: Yandex menu
user.description: Adds a "Yandex menu" panel to the sidebar; you can hide it later in the integration options. Access to the Yandex smart home is taken from the Yandex Station integration, no separate login needed.

data_description.yandex_account: Which Yandex smart home the panel works with. The list shows the accounts from the Yandex Station integration.
data_description.yaha_entry: Which Yandex Smart Home entry exposes entities to Alice. It must be linked to the same Yandex account.

abort.no_yandex_station: Set up the Yandex Station integration first — it provides access to the Yandex smart home.

data_description.yandex_account: Which Yandex smart home the panel works with. The list shows the accounts from the Yandex Station integration.
data_description.yaha_entry: Which Yandex Smart Home entry exposes entities to Alice. It must be linked to the same Yandex account.
data_description.show_in_sidebar: When hidden, the panel is still available at /yandex-menu.
